verdict.rationale: Docs and community reports confirm AI-assisted compose/reply drafting ("Compose emails with AI assistance", founder description of AI that "drafts replies") but there is no evidence the drafts adapt to the user's own voice/tone or learn from their writing style — it reads as generic AI drafting rather than personalized voice-matching. missing for 10: evidence of voice/tone personalization or learning from user's writing style, hands-on examples showing drafts matching the user's tone.
